widgets_values:
Node pack ImagePlus is available here: https://github.com/CovertBannana/ComfyUI-ImagePlus/tree/main

In your custom nodes folder do a git clone https://github.com/CovertBannana/ComfyUI-ImagePlus.git in a treminal/cmd if the node is not available in the ComfyUI Manager under Comfyui-ImagePlus.

Don't forget to reset your Denoise value back to 1 when switching to Text to Image through the Image_in toggle button.

Open Gallery will open a simple CivitAI gallery for Image inspection and standard I2I
You will need to have your CivitAI API key in the api_key.txt file in the ComfyUI-ImagePlus folder to access any images that are restricted.

Copy image URL will copy the CiviAI URL of the image and then can be retrived later via the Fetch URL button.

Open Image will open the currently loaded image in a new window.

Upload image is for accessing local images and reading their data, if any. Drop into the info panel is also supported for local images.

You'll need to click the Edit Pos or Neg buttons to change the prompts.
Clear will wipe the prompts, Restor will restore prompts from the currently loaded image.

The Info display are will not automatcally change any settings to match, is for info purposes only.

I'm using Krea2 Turbo in this example and I recomend it.

Enjoy.

Hope it helps.
